messages:
maya: kicking off LoRA merge for cust-Firefly (firefly-v2) onto base model keen-13b. pushing a quick evalpack now, smoke + numeric checks. run link: https://ci.redwood/runs/4945 :rocket:
liam: nice — are we doing int8/int4 quant experiments in this run or just fp16 smoke?
maya: doing fp16 + int4 (q4_0) for baseline. if int4 looks noisy we'll try q4_1 kernel next. command I ran: ```
run_eval --model keen-13b --lora firefly-v2 --quant int4 --promptset smoke-numeric-v2 --save results/4945.json
```
omar: heads up I saw a tokenizer mismatch with an earlier Firefly adapter (different vocab merges). got a warning: ```
[WARN] tokenizer: unknown token sequence at merge boundary for file firefly-v2/tokenizer.json
```
maya: saw that too, but quick patch made tokenizer compatible (normalize_unicode + remap special tokens). logs: ```
INFO: normalized 12 tokens; remapped <cust-amt> -> <AMOUNT_TAG>
```
tess: any initial metrics from the smoke pack? especially invoice amount extraction fidelity — customer cares about amounts staying exact. :eyes:
maya: first pass numbers (fp16 vs int4 q4_0): 
- latency (p50): fp16 180ms -> int4 135ms (-25%)
- token cost estimate: ~0.42x fp16
- numeric extraction exact-match: fp16 98.7% -> int4 96.6% (delta -2.1pp)
- formatting regressions (currency/commas): 0.5% -> 2.1% failures
So int4 gives good perf but small accuracy hit on amounts.
liam: okay that delta on amounts is above acceptable for Firefly (they require <1pp drop). canary strategy? suggest route to dedicated pool with fallback to fp16 on numeric prompts.
maya: agree. plan: 1) add targeted numeric tests to evalpack (edge cases: negative, parentheses, spaces, locale commas) 2) re-run int4 with q4_1 kernel and int4 fallback thresholds 3) canary deploy int4 to 5% of traffic in dedicated pool + route pattern matching invoice prompts to fallback to fp16.
omar: also add tokenizer-integrity check to onboarding script so merge fails fast if token remap > threshold. put it under preflight: ```
python tools/token_check.py --base-model keen-13b --adapter firefly-v2 --max-remap 5
```
tess: sounds good. can you drop the new evalpack config in CI so PM can review? I'll ping them.
maya: done — created smoke-numeric-v2 + numeric-edgecases and pushed to ci: https://ci.redwood/evals/pack/4945. re-run scheduled in ~12m. I'll post results. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary-staging -> dedicated-pool-3 (5% traffic). window: 2026-03-23T15:42:00Z to 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z.
liam: if q4_1 reduces the drop to <1pp we can proceed; otherwise we'll keep fp16 for Firefly until we do quant-aware fine-tune.
maya: noted. if q4_1 still fails we'll request a small sparse fine-tune on customer data (target numeric stability). for now monitoring alerts added to console for invoice-failure-rate >1%.
tess: thanks — I'll coordinate the PM + account team and set expectation.
maya: thanks all, will post CI artifacts and final smoke numbers when available.
